fields.Name: IT96 - Rubric Immutability Triggers
fields.Description: Deterministic server-side proof of the rubric immutability triggers. R1 changing PassThreshold on a published version throws 51102 (the version has no Weight column; PassThreshold is the frozen scoring input). R2 Published may move to Retired. R3 inserting a criterion on a published version throws 51103. R4 updating a score after submit throws 51110. R5 deleting a draft version deletes its criteria. Fixtures are rolled back. Requires RUN_MUTATION_TESTS because every check writes.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 51102, 51103 and 51110 fire; Published to Retired is allowed; a draft version delete removes its criteria.
